title: BDR intern
description: lemlist is the AI-powered sales engagement platform helping sales teams build pipeline smarter, not harder. Bootstrapped from day one, we've grown from 0 to $60M+ ARR in 8 years without raising a single dollar. Today, 40,000+ sales teams use lemlist to book more meetings and close more deals. We're building the next generation of outbound: AI-first, multi-channel, highly personalized, and deeply integrated into the way modern sales teams work. And we're just getting started. We're looking for a native English-speaking BDR Intern to help accelerate our international growth. This internship is perfect for someone starting their sales career and looking for an environment where they can learn incredibly fast. You don't need years of experience. What matters most: motivation energy communication skills resilience willingness to learn If you're ambitious and ready to work hard, we'll teach you the rest. Your Mission Your role is to generate pipeline and create opportunities for the sales team. You'll: Prospect companies across multiple markets Build outbound campaigns Personalize outreach at scale Call prospects and qualify opportunities Work closely with Account Executives Learn modern outbound strategies Use AI daily to improve productivity and results Become an expert in multichannel prospecting This is a highly operational role with a steep learning curve and massive upside. What We're Looking For Native English speaker (mandatory) First sales experience OR a strong desire to start a sales career Strong communication skills Competitive mindset Comfortable speaking with prospects Coachable and hungry to improve High energy and positive attitude Curious about AI, SaaS, and startups Bonus points if: You've already done outbound prospecting You've worked in a startup You create content or enjoy networking You love performance-driven environments Why Join lemlist Because this is not a "small BDR internship." You'll join: a profitable and fast-growing SaaS company an international environment a high-performance sales culture a company building the future of AI outbound And most importantly: there's a clear career path . We actively promote internally and want people who can grow into top performers. Several of our full-time BDRs started exactly here. What You'll Get Intense sales training Competitive internship compensation Daily coaching Exposure to top SaaS sales practices Ownership from day one A modern AI sales stack A team that genuinely cares about growth and performance The chance to accelerate your career much faster than in a traditional company Recruitment Process Interview with Victoire (TAM) Discovery call with Conor (Team Lead Europe) Business Case & debrief with Yann (VP of Sales) Interview with Charles (CEO) Join us to kickstart your sales career and help build the future of AI outbound.
